question: Out of every 100 people on Earth, how many live outside the country they were born in?
context: Everyone counted as an international migrant — workers, students, families, refugees.
why_the_gap: 304 million people (2024) — a very large number and a very small share: over 96% of people live where they were born.

question: On average, how much does it cost to send $200 home across borders?
context: Fees plus exchange-rate margin, as a percentage of the amount sent.
why_the_gap: More than double the 3% UN Sustainable Development Goal target.
